claims.claim: nie rozstrzyga, kiedy usługa musi być dostępna mimo odmowy.
claims.reason: Read the whole text of art. 7 (lines 2490-2513) and searched the full regulation text for refusal wording (odmow*, odmów*, odmaw*). Art. 7 ust. 4 (lines 2511-2513) only lists conditioning of a contract or service on consent as a factor in assessing voluntariness; it contains no rule on when a service must remain available after refusal. Recitals 42-43 (lines 508-509, 515-518) say consent is not deemed voluntary where refusal brings adverse consequences or where a contract or service is conditional on unnecessary consent, but they also state no rule that the service must be provided. Snapshot holds the full regulation text.

scope_gaps.note: No snapshot states that Android permissions and RODO consent should be checked separately, or compares them. Each mechanism is described separately by its own source; the juxtaposition is the editors' (the item says so in Ograniczenia#2).
The duty binds the controller (art. 5 ust. 1 lit. c and ust. 2), not the user. Whether RODO applies to a given app (material and territorial scope) is not claimed and was not checked.

A reader may assume the page covers every Android phone. The page says some steps work only on a Pixel phone with Android 15 or newer (line 13). It is a vendor help page, not independent evidence of any effect.

The sentence abridges art. 4 pkt 11: the full definition also requires the expression of will to be given by a statement or a clear affirmative action ('w formie oświadczenia lub wyraźnego działania potwierdzającego', line 2275). Not contradicted by the abridgement.
Absence is shown only for the text of art. 7 ust. 4 and a search of the RODO text. National law, EDPB or UODO guidance and case law were not in the snapshots and are not covered.

The sentence is general ('wybranych telefonach i wersjach systemu'). The page names a Pixel phone with Android 15 or newer for some steps, and says that on Android 15 or older one permission may be named differently (line 69).

notes: Both snapshots readable, packet warnings empty. Android page snapshot is the main article region only (4276 of 6655 chars) and the page states it may contain AI-translated text (line 115). Quotes 'Artykuł 4', 'Artykuł 6', 'Artykuł 7' (lines 2215, 2412, 2490) are shorter than 12 characters and are standalone heading lines, not table cells; I flagged them cell:true only because the article numbers in 'art. 4 pkt 11', 'art. 6 ust. 1' and 'Art. 7 ust. 4' occur in no longer quote.
